coverage_notes: Values measured in native original-template role contexts, converted from TeX pt to physical Word pt. Source native font identifiers remain in extracted_format.
Natural TeX baseline is represented as Word minimum line spacing; font availability and font substitution remain environment dependent.
Native small capitals, text case transformations, structural numbering, floats, bibliography punctuation and publisher branding remain source metadata or manual checks.
Caption alignment measured here is the one-line synthetic-caption context; long-caption breaking remains a manual check.
ASL subsection/subsubsection use run-in headings. Detailed metadata retains this structure; block formatting does not merge source paragraphs.
